source_grounded_observation: The inherited MorphologyGenesisEngine emits topology-level rewires, schedules and same-kind splits, while NativeMetaMorphologyGenesisEngine adds generator/mutator policy replacements. Neither path synthesizes an executable L1 REPRESENTATION_MEMORY_TOOL mutation that creates a previously missing artifact type from raw observations.
old_language_inadequacy_falsifier: Under a large parent MORE_COMPUTE candidate budget, no parent candidate may contain a newly synthesized REPRESENTATION organ whose executable program produces the hidden task's missing representation artifact. If the parent can reach such a program, the representation-escape claim fails.
hypothesis: A descendant representation-genesis mechanism can infer a typed representation primitive from pre-outcome support examples, synthesize an executable L1 REPRESENTATION organ, survive BODY checkpoint/restore, and solve hidden fresh queries that remain unreachable to the parent even under MORE_COMPUTE.
hidden_task_generator: After candidate implementation freeze, the evaluator-owned random seed generates 36 fresh tasks balanced across three latent primitive families: DIFFERENCE, XOR and ORDER_CANONICAL. Each task exposes only typed support input/output examples plus a fresh query before candidate execution; hidden query output is retained by the evaluator.
representation_program_contract: The descendant must infer one primitive family from support examples, bind it into a native-repr implementation_ref on a new REPRESENTATION organ, compile it without outcome access, and execute it on the hidden query. The representation organ must consume raw_observation and produce a task-unique missing artifact type.
full_control: Frozen descendant representation genesis receives task support examples and typed artifact requirement only, synthesizes at most one L1 representation candidate, checkpoint/restores the BODY, then executes the restored representation program on the hidden query.
remove_control: The frozen parent MorphologyGenesisEngine and NativeMetaMorphologyGenesisEngine receive the same typed residual and support metadata with a candidate budget of 4096. Any success through a newly synthesized executable representation program invalidates the representation-escape claim.
wrong_control: Force a different representation primitive family than the inferred family while preserving task artifact identity; hidden accuracy must be below FULL.
shuffle_control: Bind support examples from a different hidden task to the current task artifact/query; hidden accuracy must be below FULL.
restart_control: Checkpoint/restore before hidden query execution must preserve the generated representation organ fingerprint and program behavior exactly.
